data.one_liner: High‑performance particle animation widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable particle system with physics, lifetime animations, and interaction. It renders shapes, trails, and supports burst emitters and boundary behaviors.
use_when: Need animated particle effects like confetti, fireworks, or background stars
Want fine‑grained control over particle lifetime, color, scale, and interaction
Require a reusable widget that can be dropped into any Flutter layout
avoid_when: You only need simple static graphics or basic animations
Your project targets very low‑end devices where performance is critical
weaknesses: No code generation or hooks support
Large API surface can be overwhelming for beginners
data.setup_notes: Add dependency via flutter pub add particles_flutter; no permissions or build_runner needed

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler animation library for basic effects, but lacks particle physics and lifetime control
